Sound familiar?

Knowing more about food hasn't made it feel simpler

  • Every new plan starts on a Monday, and by the weekend the rules feel impossible.
  • Food takes up more headspace than you'd like it to.
  • You could recite the "good" and "bad" lists, but eating still feels complicated.
  • You want to feel at home in your body without signing up for another programme of rules.

Here's what you'll learn

Your 60 minutes, step by step

Step 1: Why diets keep ending the same way

What dieting does to the way you think about food, and why stopping is the first step, not the last.

Step 2: What food freedom looks like day to day

How to give yourself permission to eat without the guilt spiral, and why that makes food feel calmer.

Step 3: Gentle nutrition, without rules

How a dietitian thinks about nutrition once the rules are gone, and how to add it back gently.

Step 4: Body respect

Practical ways to treat your body with kindness and care, starting today.

Your next step

One thing to practise this week, and how to keep going after the class.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Is this another diet?

No. There are no meal plans, no rules and no tracking. It's a class about stepping off the diet cycle and building a calmer relationship with food.

Is this medical advice?

No. It's an educational class from a registered dietitian. It doesn't diagnose or treat any condition and doesn't replace care from your own doctor or care team.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, learn the four steps, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Script 1 · "The Monday reset"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Why does every new diet seem to start on a Monday?"

Body

"Because diets run on rules, and rules come with a start date and a slip-up date. Intuitive eating swaps the rules for skills you keep. As a dietitian, I teach it in four steps, and step one is simpler than you'd think."

CTA

"I'm teaching all four live in a 60-minute masterclass. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat."

Shot: talking to camera, same warm setup as your reels. On-screen text: "Monday again?"

Script 2 · "Gentle nutrition"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's what I wish more people knew about nutrition, as a dietitian."

Body

"Nutrition matters. But it works best as step three, not step one. When nutrition comes first, it turns into another set of rules. When it comes after food freedom, it feels like care instead of control."

CTA

"I'll show you all four steps in the Food Freedom Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple graphic of the 4 steps with step 3 highlighted in coral.

Script 3 · "Freedom isn't chaos"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Food freedom doesn't mean anything goes."

Body

"It means food stops being a moral test. No good foods, no bad foods, just information and choice. That's what lets eating feel calm, and it's what makes gentle nutrition stick later on."

CTA

"Come learn the four steps with me live. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera, text overlay "Not chaos. Calm." with "calm" highlighted.

Every ad caption ends with: Educational content, not medical advice. No weight, body-size or health-outcome claims.
